privacyExportDescription: Download a JSON copy of your profile, consent record, submitted questionnaires, saved risk assessments, and connected health app data. The export is limited to your account and is not stored separately by the app.
privacyExportEmpty: Your export was downloaded. You have no saved questionnaire or risk assessment records yet.
privacyExportError: We could not export your data. Check your connection and try again.
privacyRetentionDescription: The app does not currently publish an automatic retention period or provide self-service account deletion. You can delete data imported from connected health apps under Connected health apps on this page. Contact your app administrator to ask about deleting the rest of your account data. Downloaded export files are stored on your device and are not deleted by the app.
privacyConsentGranted: Health data consent is currently recorded for your account.
privacyConsentNotGranted: Health data consent is not currently recorded for your account.
privacyConsentDescription: Health features require current consent. Consent cannot currently be withdrawn from settings; contact your app administrator with questions. Optional marketing consent is separate from health-feature consent.

connectedApps.title: Connected health apps
connectedApps.description: Connected apps can only read the types of data you allowed, and this app never sends data back to them. Disconnecting stops new imports. Deleting imported data removes it from this app only. It does not change anything stored in the other app.
connectedApps.loadError: We could not load your connected health apps. Check your connection and try again.
connectedApps.empty: You have not connected any health apps, so no data has been imported.
connectedApps.disconnectDescription: {{provider}} will stop sending new data to this app. Data already imported stays in your account unless you choose to delete it. You can connect again later.
connectedApps.disconnectAlsoDelete_one: Also delete the {{count}} record already imported from {{provider}}
connectedApps.disconnectAlsoDelete_other: Also delete the {{count}} records already imported from {{provider}}
connectedApps.deleteDescription_one: This permanently deletes {{count}} record imported from {{provider}} and cannot be undone. Data you entered yourself is not affected, and nothing is deleted from {{provider}}.
connectedApps.deleteDescription_other: This permanently deletes {{count}} records imported from {{provider}} and cannot be undone. Data you entered yourself is not affected, and nothing is deleted from {{provider}}.
connectedApps.deleteStillConnected: {{provider}} is still connected, so new data may be imported later. Disconnect it to stop new imports.
connectedApps.disconnectSuccess: {{provider}} has been disconnected. No new data will be imported.
connectedApps.disconnectAndDeleteSuccess_one: {{provider}} has been disconnected and {{count}} imported record was deleted.
connectedApps.disconnectAndDeleteSuccess_other: {{provider}} has been disconnected and {{count}} imported records were deleted.
connectedApps.deleteEmpty: There was no data imported from {{provider}} to delete.
connectedApps.disconnectError: We could not disconnect {{provider}}. Check your connection and try again.
connectedApps.deleteError: We could not delete the data imported from {{provider}}. Check your connection and try again.
connectedApps.notFound: This connection no longer exists. The list has been refreshed.
